title: Batman: Watch Bruce Wayne Fight His Eventual Replacement in First 10 Minutes of New Movie
content:
Batman fights a dangerous masked vigilante within the first 10 minutes of the new animated movie. Batman: Knightfall Part 1 wastes little time putting Bruce Wayne into another brutal battle. The fight also introduces a character who will become important to Batman’s future. The story starts after Bane destroys Arkham Asylum and releases its inmates. […]
